# Phil Gordon

[Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college)

## Appearance

Phil Gordon is characterized by her big brown eyes, brown tints, and a crooked smile. She also features a nose that follows the Gordon pattern.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 ch.Interlude P5](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0005), [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003)_

## Personality

Phil Gordon is a pretty, sweet, and goodhearted individual who possesses a natural knack for making people like her. She considers her personal mission to charm and allure, while demonstrating practical abilities such as deft embroidery skills, dishwashing, and sweeping floors.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Interlude P37](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0037), [v3 ch.Speaks P7](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0007), [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Confidences P31](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0031)_

## History

Philippa "Phil" Gordon hailed from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), where she belonged to an old, exclusive Bluenose family as the daughter of a rich, well-known man. After registering at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), she met [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) in Old St. John's Cemetery and quickly befriended them. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) arranged to rent Patty's Place for their second year, Phil begged and received permission to live with them. She later invited [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to spend a fortnight at her home in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke). Over time, Phil fell in love with a theological student named [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/jonas.md), and she eventually accepted his marriage proposal after he popped the question. During her final year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Phil comforted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rejected a marriage proposal from Royal Gardner.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Lady P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), +19 more_

## Quotes

> "I’ll go, if I can walk with Priscilla and Charlie. That will be a bearable degree of gooseberry. That Gilbert of yours is a darling, Anne, but why does he go around so much with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "I don’t want William’s Island especially, but I’m sure I couldn’t get it if I did. Look at that sentry on the summit of the fort, right beside the flag. Doesn’t he look as if he had stepped out of a romance?"
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P25](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0025)

> "Look—in white letters, around the archway over the gate. ‘Patty’s Place.’ Isn’t that killing? Especially on this Avenue of Pinehursts and Elmwolds and Cedarcrofts? ‘Patty’s Place,’ if you please! I adore it."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

> "They really are such dear boys, you know. There’s to be no end of dances and drives and general jamborees. I shall never forgive you, Queen Anne, for not coming home with me for the holidays."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "There’ll be one or two quilting parties, I suppose; and all the old gossips will talk you over to your face and behind your back. You’ll die of lonesomeness, child."
>
> — Phil Gordon — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phil-gordon.md)

Phil instantly befriends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after meeting her in Old St. John's Cemetery during their first year at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Phil introduces [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her broad social circle, stays in touch through letters during college breaks, and later begs to join Anne's household at Patty's Place. Their close bond eventually leads to Phil serving as a bridesmaid for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P12](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0012), [v3 ch.Lady P21](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0021), +29 more_
